command_line:
set -eu
cat > analyze.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
input_path <- args[[1]]
output_path <- args[[2]]

d <- read.delim(input_path, header=TRUE, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE, quote="")
if (!all(c("Efficacy", "Age") %in% names(d))) stop("Required columns Efficacy and Age are missing")
d <- d[nzchar(trimws(as.character(d$Efficacy))) & nzchar(trimws(as.character(d$Age))), , drop=FALSE]
d$response <- ifelse(d$Efficacy == "PR", 1L, ifelse(d$Efficacy %in% c("SD", "PD"), 0L, NA_integer_))
if (anyNA(d$response)) stop("Unexpected efficacy category")
d$age <- as.numeric(as.character(d$Age))
if (anyNA(d$age)) stop("Non-numeric age")
if (length(unique(d$response)) != 2L) stop("Response is not binary")
fit <- glm(response ~ age, data=d, family=binomial(link="logit"))
age_coefficient <- unname(coef(fit)[["age"]])
if (is.na(age_coefficient)) stop("Age coefficient is NA")
write.table(data.frame(term="age", coefficient=age_coefficient), file=output_path, sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
RSCRIPT
